subject: GovTech POC orchestration & API handoff
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@govtech.es>, Alex Novak <alex.novak@city-portal.gov>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: GovTech POC orchestration & API handoff

Hi Marta / Alex —

Great to speak earlier. Per our discovery, here’s a concise recap + proposed POC plan so we can align on scope, success criteria, timeline, and ownership before the kickoff. Please reply with any edits or confirm and we’ll lock the kickoff.

Recap (what you told us)
- Goal: Improve citizen search relevance for permit queries and reduce manual triage by 60%.
- Primary flows: free-text search, structured filters, and an automated follow-up action that calls GovTech’s case-lookup API for flagged results.
- Non-functional: <200ms p50 for lookup path, audit logs for each inference, and data retention limited to 30 days.

Proposed POC (3-week trial)
1) Success criteria (mutually validated):
   - Precision@10 for target queries improves by >=20% vs. baseline (you provide sample queries+labels).
   - Average end-to-end latency for search+lookup path < 350ms at 5qps.
   - Tool-calling integration executes GovTech lookup with authenticated request and response recorded in audit log.
2) Evaluation plan:
   - Week 0: Prep — agree test queries/labels, grant sandbox API keys, share sample dataset (anonymized).
   - Week 1: Integration — SDK routing + streaming enabled; wire tool-calling for lookup; ingest 1k test queries.
   - Week 2: Run load + measurements; iterate prompt/template & batching params.
   - Week 3: Final evaluation, handoff doc, and next-steps recommendation.
3) Ownership
   - GovTech: provide sandbox keys, sample labeled queries, a point-of-contact for internal APIs (Alex).
   - Redwood: integration lead (Monica) for SDK routes & streaming, eng support (Sergio) for tool-calling wiring, and CS (Laura) for metric collection and dashboards.
4) Tech notes (high level)
   - Recommended model: redwood/small-gen-1 (quantized) for initial latency testing; we’ll provide a variant if quality needs improving.
   - APIs: use POST /v1/generate for search reranking; streaming for tokens when we surface partial hits; function-calling for the lookup trigger (we’ll sign the outbound call to your sandbox URL).
   - Security: option to run in Dedicated or Private with VPC peering; audit logs available via Console.

Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx (detailed tasks), redwood-api-routing-diagram.png

Next steps: please confirm the success criteria and your preferred kickoff window (we suggested Mon 20 Sep or Tue 21 Sep). If good, we’ll send a calendar invite + a short SOW (DocuSign) for sign-off.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@govtech.es>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Alex Novak <alex.novak@city-portal.gov>
Cc: Alex Novak <alex.novak@city-portal.gov>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 10:02:00 +0200
Subject: Re: GovTech POC orchestration & API handoff

Thanks Priyom — good summary. A few clarifications and asks from our security/compliance side before we sign off the kickoff: 

1) Data handling: the sample dataset will be pseudonymized but we need confirmation that Redwood will not persist raw inputs beyond 30 days in the sandbox.
2) Audit logs: must include request_id, model_version, timestamp, and the outbound call metadata (URL called, status code).
3) Tool calling: the lookup needs to authenticate via mutual TLS (mTLS). Can Redwood support outbound mTLS for function/tool calls to our sandbox endpoint?
4) SOC2 evidence: we’ll need a short SOC2 summary and key controls during the POC phase.

Kickoff: Mon 20 Sep works for us (10:00 CET). Please include the engineering owners on the invite.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Integrations — GovTech City Portal
marta.ruiz@govtech.es
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: GovTech POC orchestration & API handoff — engineering input needed

FYI forwarding Marta’s reply — they accepted the proposed plan but have three blocking items we need to confirm before kickoff: data retention (30d), audit log fields, and outbound mTLS for the function-calling lookup.

Can you each reply with a short implementation note by EOD Weds (15 Sep)? Specifically:
- Monica: SDK routing + streaming changes needed; which endpoints and example payloads should we send to them? Rough ETA (days) to wire this in our sandbox.
- Sergio: tool-calling / function invocation — can we support mTLS on outbound calls from our runtime? If not, what proxied/auth option is acceptable? Also list risk/rollback if we hit latency issues.
- Laura: dashboarding / metrics instrumentation — do we have existing templates for Precision@10, latency p50/p95, and audit log ingestion to their endpoint? Any gaps to call out.

I attached the initial checklist and the API routing diagram. I’ll collect replies and send a consolidated plan to Marta + Alex by Fri.

Subject: RE: GovTech POC orchestration & API handoff — confirmed plan + kickoff invite

Hi Marta / Alex —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for confirming the kickoff slot. Per internal alignment, here’s the agreed implementation plan and what we’ll deliver in the POC. Please see attached files and the HubSpot link for the signed SOW draft.

Agreed success criteria (finalized)
- Precision@10 increases >=20% on your 1,000 labeled test queries.
- End-to-end median latency for the search+lookup flow < 350ms at 5qps (p50); p95 under 700ms.
- Tool-calling executed via mutual TLS with audit entries for each call (fields: request_id, model_version, timestamp, outbound_url, status_code).

Implementation summary (what Redwood will do)
- SDK & API routes: use POST /v1/generate (payload=search_prompts) and POST /v1/tools/call for the lookup. Example payloads attached in the diagram. Monica will push the sandbox routing within 2 business days.
- Streaming: enabled on generate for partial result streaming to reduce perceived latency for long-form reranking paths.
- Tool-calling / mTLS: Sergio confirmed we can initiate outbound mTLS from our Dedicated runtime; we’ll use an intermediate connection manager to ensure cert rotations and observability.
- Data retention: sandbox logs and raw inputs will be purged after 30 days; we’ll provide a purge confirmation report at the end of the trial.
- Observability: Laura will publish a shared dashboard (read-only) with Precision@10, p50/p95 latencies, throughput, and a table of audit log entries.

Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx, redwood-api-routing-diagram.png, soc2-evidence-summary.pdf
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GovTechPOC, https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/1234567890

Next steps:
1) I’ve sent the calendar invite for Mon 20 Sep 10:00 CET with MCU dial-in + Zoom — please accept.
2) Marta: paste sandbox mTLS endpoint and cert thumbprint in the shared Drive folder.
3) GovTech: upload labeled queries (CSV) to the Drive folder before Wed 22 Sep.

If anything changes we’ll escalate, but otherwise we’ll proceed to the integration sprint on Mon. Looking forward to kicking this off.

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
